"import cadquery as cq

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Regular 12-sided polygon (dodecagon) in the YZ plane, given in LOCAL sketch
# coordinates (u, v) [mm].
#
# Authoritative parameters (for reference):
#   center            = (8.0, 6.0)
#   circumradius      = 15.0
#   side count        = 12
#   first vertex      = -49 deg (CCW from local +X)
#
# The explicit vertex values below are used verbatim (no grid snapping).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
vertices = [
    (17.840885, -5.320644),
    (22.182779, 1.116478),
    (22.724408, 8.862135),
    (19.320644, 15.840885),
    (12.883522, 20.182779),
    (5.137865, 20.724408),
    (-1.840885, 17.320644),
    (-6.182779, 10.883522),
    (-6.724408, 3.137865),
    (-3.320644, -3.840885),
    (3.116478, -8.182779),
    (10.862135, -8.724408),
]

# YZ plane: local u -> global +Y, local v -> global +Z
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Map local sketch coordinates to world coordinates
world_pts = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in vertices]

# Build exactly 12 line edges forming one closed profile
# (V1->V2, V2->V3, ..., V12->V1)
edges = []
for i in range(len(world_pts)):
    p1 = world_pts[i]
    p2 = world_pts[(i + 1) % len(world_pts)]
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(p1, p2))

# Sanity checks: exactly 12 entities, single closed loop, all coplanar (x = 0)
assert len(edges) == 12, "Expected exactly 12 curve entities"
for i in range(len(edges)):
    end_pt = edges[i].endPoint()
    start_next = edges[(i + 1) % len(edges)].startPoint()
    assert (end_pt - start_next).Length < 1e-6, "Loop is not closed at edge %d" % i
for e in edges:
    for v in e.Vertices():
        assert abs(v.X) < 1e-9, "Entity not on the YZ plane (x != 0)"

# Export the curves as a compound of edges
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
